strategy: Continue easy/high-yield first-party resolution queue. Promote only current CPO-specific anonymous ad-hoc tariffs with explicit energy and applicable time/blocking rules; leave ambiguous or stale cases partial and move on.

promotions.name: Stadtwerke Muenster / Momente
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Muenster page publishes a tariff explicitly valid from 2026-04-01 and separately identifies Kreditkarte/Ad-Hoc-Ladung. QR plus credit-card payment requires no substitution from Momente Card or roaming. Anonymous ad-hoc is 0.47 EUR/kWh AC plus 0.05 EUR/min after 240 minutes, and 0.52 EUR/kWh DC plus 0.05 EUR/min after 60 minutes. The time component applies 06:00-22:00; minutes continue counting overnight but no time charge is levied 22:00-06:00. At parking garages and P+R, the AC stand component starts after 480 minutes according to the first-party exception note.

anonymousAdHoc.access: QR at charge point + credit card

promotions.name: Stadtwerke Duesseldorf
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Duesseldorf tariff page explicitly publishes Ad-hoc Laden effective 2026-04-01 for Stadtwerke Duesseldorf charge points: 0.48 EUR/kWh AC and 0.60 EUR/kWh DC. The same table gives the usage fee: 0.10 EUR/min between 08:00 and 21:00 after four hours AC or one hour DC. This is explicitly the anonymous ad-hoc layer and remains separate from Stadtwerke charging-card and roaming tariffs.

Historical Hof ad-hoc tariff sheets must not be ingested as a current Stadtwerke-Hof CPO tariff. Requires canonical operator-identity reconciliation rather than tariff promotion.

Current Mobilithek-derived station records show site/power-class values that differ, so no card-to-ad-hoc equivalence is inferred.

easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.name: Stadtwerke Amberg / SWA-E-Charge

easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.name: Stadtwerke Kulmbach
easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.reason: Current first-party site enumerates public stations but does not publish a complete anonymous tariff matrix. A current Mobilithek-derived station record shows 0.40 EUR/kWh AC with no start/blocking fee at one station only; this is insufficient for estate-wide promotion.

easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.name: Stadtwerke Dachau
easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.reason: Two live first-party pages conflict for anonymous AC: one direct-payment section gives 0.65 EUR/kWh plus blocking/minimum-spend rules while the station page says charging without card currently costs 0.69 EUR/kWh. Requires live checkout or dated artifact before promotion.

easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.name: Stadtwerke Schweinfurt
easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.reason: Current first-party page maps charge-it-easy to 0.55 EUR/kWh and confirms use without registration, but current Mobilithek/LichtBlick-derived station evidence exposes a materially different station tariff structure (0.462 EUR/kWh plus time component) on at least one SW Schweinfurt EVSE. Keep fail-closed until current direct-price scope is reconciled.

easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.name: Stadtwerke Trostberg
easyQueueCheckedButStillPartial.reason: Binding 2025-2026 first-party price sheet gives ladeapp ad-hoc 0.59 EUR/kWh, but first-party Ladeapp AGB states costs can vary by charge point. Exact current per-EVSE equivalence across the four public sites is not yet proven, so no network-wide promotion.

nextSafeAction: Continue the easy first-party queue beyond LadeVerbundPlus, prioritizing current pages that explicitly publish Kreditkarte/QR/Ad-hoc tariff rows and complete fee rules. Candidates without current anonymous equivalence are immediately parked for later backend/AFIR reconciliation. After easy first-party yield drops, batch chargecloud/Mobilithek B1/B3/B6 cases.
